title: Department accreditation required.
bodyText: The department shall pursue and obtain accreditation from the Commission on Accreditation for Law Enforcement Agencies, Inc., for all divisions and sections within the department.
bodyHtml: §353C-9  Department accreditation required.  The department shall pursue and obtain accreditation from the Commission on Accreditation for Law Enforcement Agencies, Inc., for all divisions and sections within the department. [L 2011, c 111, §2; am L 2024, c 131, §3]
